summary: IREN Ltd filed an 8-K announcing a proposed $2 billion offering of convertible senior notes due 2033, with an additional $300 million option for initial purchasers. Proceeds will partly fund capped call transactions and general corporate purposes. This is a capital raising event, not a special-situation transaction such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. The notes are unregistered Rule 144A private placements. No special situation exists; thus, the filing is classified as None. No deal terms such as price per share or premium are applicable; the focus is solely on the note issuance mechanics and use of proceeds.
